author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/43-federation.md — REQ-3, AC-2 + decomposition PR 4.

## Surface
- Extend `polaris-backend/src/federation/publish.rs` with `publish_escalation_message()`.
- Extend `polaris-backend/src/federation/peer_subscribe.rs` to recognize `polaris.escalation-message` NSIDs and append to `federation_messages`.
- New frontend module: `polaris-frontend/src/components/federation_thread.rs` — cross-instance thread UI.
- Extend `polaris-backend/src/api/cases.rs` GET handler to include federation messages in the case-view DTO.
- Extend `polaris-frontend/src/api_client/dto.rs` with `FederationMessage` + `FederationThread` shapes.

## Conversation semantics
- Each `polaris.escalation-message` is signed by the SENDING instance's labeler key.
- Receiving instance verifies the signature against the sender's `app.bsky.labeler.service` declared public key (resolver cached from PR 1).
- Messages are append-only on both sides; ordering is by record CID + signed timestamp; ties broken by source DID lexicographic order.
- Attribution in the UI: "instance:<did:plc:...>" — never "moderator:<id>" (REQ-5).

## Rust-quality notes
- **Reuse the privacy boundary**: `to_lexicon_escalation_message()` (in #103 mapping module) strips the moderator_id and replaces with the instance DID. Don't enforce in this PR's publish code.
- **Thread reconstruction is deterministic.** Given a set of `FederationMessage` rows, the ordering function returns the same Vec for any input order (sort by `(signed_at, source_did)`). Property test asserts this.
- **Frontend thread component** takes `messages: &[FederationMessage]` by reference, not by value (rust-quality §2). Renders attribution as the instance DID with a hover-card showing the peer's labeler service record.
- The case-view DTO grows by one field: `federation_threads: Vec<FederationThread>`. Add a serde_default on this so existing case-view consumers don't break.
- The peer subscription handler in PR 1 grows a `match nsid` arm for `polaris.escalation-message` that appends to `federation_messages` and updates the parent escalation's `last_event_at`.

## External references
- Existing case-view DTO: `polaris-frontend/src/api_client/dto.rs`
- Existing thread-UI reference (single-instance): `polaris-frontend/src/components/history_timeline.rs`
- ATProto signed-record timestamp semantics: https://atproto.com/specs/repository

## Acceptance (AC-2)
- [ ] Two-instance fixture: A escalates to B; B posts a reply message; A verifies the signature against B's labeler.service pubkey; A renders the message in the case view attributed to `instance:<B-DID>`.
- [ ] Forged signature test: B sends a message with a tampered signature; A logs WARN and discards (does not surface in UI).
